title: Clash in Cleveland
status: Historical review of the package merged in PR #17; author review pending
supersededBy: docs/editorial/book-four-action-restoration-review.json supersedes Chapter 12 and the export measurements below. This file preserves the earlier completion review as a historical snapshot.
scope: Complete Chapters 12–13 and their illustrations; review continuity and validate all 13 reader chapters and rebuilt publishing exports.

chapters.title: Something’s Wrong
chapters.continuityReview: Reduced strength and speed are tested in the beam rescue; the team asks for help and Eddie is removed after the beam is supported.

chapters.title: Not Fast Enough
chapters.continuityReview: The robbers escape; the Defenders prioritize Frank and the clerk. Dork learns only what the newspaper reports.

chapters.title: Dork’s Opportunity
chapters.continuityReview: The intact Army ray is demonstrated with blue shrinking and red restoration. Dork starts the tank but does not steal the vault yet; Laura conceals weakness.

chapters.title: More Power
chapters.continuityReview: Flaming Head departs hopefully for the Sun. Only Seth and Jenny hear him directly; Seth relays to Billy and Fist.

chapters.title: Into the Light
chapters.continuityReview: A solitary solar journey ends inside the light, without a Cleveland cutaway, return or survival reveal.

chapters.title: The Missing Vault
chapters.continuityReview: The separate vault is stolen and restored. Teeth and torch fail; Laura delays while still weak.

chapters.title: Something Big
chapters.continuityReview: Billy connects the ray, tank, building and vault reports but has not located the laboratory or established guilt solely from the clippings.

chapters.title: More Than Before
chapters.continuityReview: Seth and Jenny recover stronger familiar powers. Laura discovers stronger plasma only when pressed to open the vault. Money moves to the workbench and drawer.

chapters.title: Bow to Dork
chapters.continuityReview: Dork retrofits the ray into a fixed forward turret with a wired driver control. Only empty police cars are shrunk. Billy organizes a safe route.

chapters.title: Lava Lips and Pink Blur
chapters.continuityReview: Laura removes her burned coat before the hydrant maneuver; sideward water ends the fight but does not remove her power. She is cuffed under extinguisher coverage.

chapters.title: Clash at the Tower
chapters.continuityReview: Fist immediately attacks Jaws, who does not recognize him. Seth deflects one shot away from intact Terminal Tower; its destination stays unseen and the turret remains attached.

chapters.title: Off Comes the Top
chapters.continuityReview: The turret is removed, the cable disconnects, and Dork leaves via the forward driver hatch. The ray is physically unfastened and moved clear before the empty tank is smashed. Jaws is held and braced; Laura chooses surrender under continued supervision.

chapters.title: For the Land
chapters.continuityReview: Jaws receives a fixed cage and bolted jaw brace; Laura remains powered and guarded with hose coverage. Police find the laboratory through Billy and a witness, count both vault and drawer money, and Army technicians restore only empty cars. Flaming Head stays absent.

preservation.chapters1Through11: Unchanged byte for byte from baseline

newDraftChoices: Fist forces Jaws’s metal jaw closed; Seth holds it and folds a recovered steel mounting strap around the metal casing, with nose/eyes clear. A bolted brace and fixed cage maintain custody without removing flight or restoring memories.
Laura chooses surrender under Jenny’s watch and a charged hose. Separate transport, fire crew escort and a guarded cleared masonry wash bay continue containment without curing her power.
Billy and a driver’s witness account locate the laboratory; officers inventory both the vault money and the bundles removed to the drawer.
Army personnel restore the empty police cars in a cleared area; the final facility-window scene honors Flaming Head’s absence and ends with the team helping neighbors.
